runner_contract.required_decode_carrier_policy: one-token-h2d or last-token-d2d; same-binary comparisons must hold every other case-identity field fixed
runner_contract.required_draft_feature_policy: fixed-16 is the rollback baseline; committed-prefix is an inactive exact candidate; same-binary and same-OM-hash comparisons must hold every other case-identity field fixed
runner_contract.required_prefill_completion_policy: separate is the rollback baseline; coalesce-first-verify is an inactive exact candidate that delays first-token visibility; same-binary and same-OM-hash comparisons must report TTFT and model-total separately
runner_contract.required_device_memory_allocation_policy: runner reports must contain normal-only or huge-first; normal-only is the rollback default, huge-first requires separate same-source binaries and forward/reverse-order same-device unprofiled 3+10 evidence with identical OM hashes and zero token/EOS mismatch
runner_contract.current_integrated_om_io: persistent input device mirror with changed-range H2D; Target D2H tail is bounded by K+1; full Draft ID D2H; one stream synchronization per model execution
runner_contract.incremental_five_om_io: one aligned prefill control carrier uploads only the live base/count/proposal/full prefix while its EOS tail stays process-resident; compact Target results ping-pong with Target state; one-token-h2d retains direct row-zero binding and falls back to pinned-host H2D after multi-token commits, while last-token-d2d retains every last committed token and copies later rows D2D into the aligned scalar; an explicit caller override uses the exact 8-byte H2D fallback in either policy; exact DFlash synchronization windows 2..8 may queue budget-safe complete transactions before one barrier, with window 2 using the ping-pong slots directly and windows 3..8 staging compact results D2D into an eight-slot arena; exact coalesce-first-verify may queue final prefill and the first verify before one contiguous compact D2H/barrier; the same Draft OM exposes N=1..16 verify gears so committed-prefix can omit masked scratch feature rows without changing tensor order or weights
required_io_counters: speculative_window_staging_operations, bytes, device bytes and pinned-host bytes
prefill_verify_d2h_operations_elided, slot counts and padding bytes
prefill_control full/base/count/proposal operations, bytes and elided bytes
